name: Shreshta Yadav
role: Software Engineer · backend systems, security and local-first AI
bio: I'm a software engineer at AT&T, where I build TypeScript and NestJS services and helped move a legacy Express monolith to microservices. I studied Computer Science at Georgia Tech and was a teaching assistant for Computer Systems & Networks. Outside work I'm building NetKnight and Engawa: local-first systems in Rust, Python and TypeScript designed around safety, verification and privacy.
availability: Software Engineer at AT&T · Georgia Tech B.S. Computer Science, 2025 · Atlanta, GA
